original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure EPEL repository is enabled (EL9)
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: epel-release
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"

  tasks:
    - name: Install required packages
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - libpwquality
          - audit
          - fail2ban
        state: present

    - name: Configure password quality requirements
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*{{ item.key }}\s*='
        line: '{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}'
        create: true
        backup: true
      loop: "{{ pwquality_settings }}"
      vars:
        pwquality_settings:
          - { key: minlen, value: 14 }
          - { key: dcredit, value: -1 }
          - { key: ucredit, value: -1 }
          - { key: lcredit, value: -1 }
          - { key: ocredit, value: -1 }
          - { key: minclass, value: 4 }
          - { key: maxrepeat, value: 3 }
          - { key: dictcheck, value: 1 }
          - { key: enforce_for_root, value: 1 }

    - name: Ensure sshd include directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy SSH hardening snippet
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - SSH hardening
          PermitRootLogin no
          PasswordAuthentication yes
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          UsePAM yes
          X11Forwarding no
          ClientAliveInterval 300
          ClientAliveCountMax 2
          LoginGraceTime 30
          MaxAuthTries 3
          AllowAgentForwarding no
          AllowTcpForwarding no
      notify: Validate and restart sshd

    - name: Ensure sshd service enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Gather service facts
      ansible.builtin.service_facts:

    - name: Determine if firewalld is available
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        use_firewalld: "{{ ('firewalld.service' in ansible_facts.services) and (ansible_facts.services['firewalld.service'].state in ['running', 'stopped']) }}"

    - name: Configure fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        backup: true
        content: |
          [DEFAULT]
          bantime = 1h
          findtime = 10m
          maxretry = 5
          backend = systemd
          usedns = warn
          destemail = root@localhost
          sender = fail2ban@{{ ansible_fqdn | default(inventory_hostname) }}
          mta = sendmail
          banaction = {{ 'firewallcmd-rich-rules' if use_firewalld else 'iptables-multiport' }}
          action = %(action_)s

          [sshd]
          enabled = true
          backend = systemd
          port = ssh
          logpath = %(sshd_log)s
          filter = sshd
          banaction = {{ 'firewallcmd-rich-rules' if use_firewalld else 'iptables-multiport' }}
          maxretry = 5
      notify: Validate and reload fail2ban

    - name: Ensure fail2ban service enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Configure auditd - log format
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*log_format\s*='
        line: 'log_format = ENRICHED'
        backup: true
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Configure auditd - max log file size
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*max_log_file\s*='
        line: 'max_log_file = 50'
        backup: true
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Configure auditd - number of rotated logs
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*num_logs\s*='
        line: 'num_logs = 7'
        backup: true
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Configure auditd - space left and actions
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED SPACE ACTIONS"
        block: |
          space_left = 75
          space_left_action = email
          action_mail_acct = root
          admin_space_left = 50
          admin_space_left_action = single
          disk_full_action = halt
          disk_error_action = halt
        backup: true
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Determine if 32-bit audit arch rules are needed
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        audit_has_b32: "{{ ansible_facts['architecture'] == 'x86_64' }}"

    - name: Deploy baseline audit rules
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - baseline audit rules

          ## Time change monitoring
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,clock_settime -k time-change
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,stime -k time-change
          {% endif %}
          -w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

          ## Identity and account databases
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity

          ## Sudoers
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope
          -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope

          ## SSH configuration
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k ssh
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ -p wa -k ssh

          ## Login and authentication logs
          -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k authfail
          -w /var/log/tallylog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/secure -p wa -k auth

          ## System locale and hostname/domain changes
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S sethostname,setdomainname -k system-locale
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S sethostname,setdomainname -k system-locale
          {% endif %}

          ## MAC policy (SELinux) changes
          -w /etc/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy

          ## Unauthorized access attempts (file access denials)
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          {% endif %}

          ## File permission and ownership modifications
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,utime,utimes,utimensat -k perm_mod
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,utime,utimes,utimensat -k perm_mod
          {% endif %}

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,finit_module,delete_module -k modules
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module,delete_module -k modules
          {% endif %}

          ## Audit configuration changes
          -w /etc/audit/auditd.conf -p wa -k auditconfig
          -w /etc/audit/rules.d/ -p wa -k auditconfig
          -w /etc/libaudit.conf -p wa -k auditconfig
      notify: Reload audit rules

    - name: Ensure auditd service enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Validate and restart sshd
      listen: Validate and restart sshd
      block:
        - name: Validate sshd configuration
          ansible.builtin.command: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
        - name: Restart sshd
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: sshd
            state: restarted
            enabled: true

    - name: Validate and reload fail2ban
      listen: Validate and reload fail2ban
      block:
        - name: Validate fail2ban configuration
          ansible.builtin.command: fail2ban-client -d
        - name: Reload fail2ban
          ansible.builtin.command: fail2ban-client reload
        - name: Ensure fail2ban is running
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: fail2ban
            state: started
            enabled: true

    - name: Reload audit rules
      listen: Reload audit rules
      ansible.builtin.command: /sbin/augenrules --load

    - name: Restart auditd
      listen: Restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted

        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - baseline audit rules

          ## Time change monitoring
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,clock_settime -k time-change
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,stime -k time-change
          {% endif %}
          -w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

          ## Identity and account databases
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity

          ## Sudoers
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope
          -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope

          ## SSH configuration
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k ssh
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ -p wa -k ssh

          ## Login and authentication logs
          -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/run/faillock/ -p wa -k authfail
          -w /var/log/tallylog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/secure -p wa -k auth

          ## System locale and hostname/domain changes
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S sethostname,setdomainname -k system-locale
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S sethostname,setdomainname -k system-locale
          {% endif %}

          ## MAC policy (SELinux) changes
          -w /etc/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy

          ## Unauthorized access attempts (file access denials)
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -k access
          {% endif %}

          ## File permission and ownership modifications
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,utime,utimes,utimensat -k perm_mod
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,utime,utimes,utimensat -k perm_mod
          {% endif %}

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,finit_module,delete_module -k modules
          {% if audit_has_b32 %}
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module,delete_module -k modules
          {% endif %}

          ## Audit configuration changes
          -w /etc/audit/auditd.conf -p wa -k auditconfig
          -w /etc/audit/rules.d/ -p wa -k auditconfig
          -w /etc/libaudit.conf -p wa -k auditconfig
      notify: Reload audit rules

    - name: Ensure auditd service enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Validate and restart sshd
      listen: Validate and restart sshd
      block:
        - name: Validate sshd configuration
          ansible.builtin.command: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
        - name: Restart sshd
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: sshd
            state: restarted
            enabled: true

    - name: Validate and reload fail2ban
      listen: Validate and reload fail2ban
      block:
        - name: Validate fail2ban configuration
          ansible.builtin.command: fail2ban-client -d
        - name: Reload fail2ban
          ansible.builtin.command: fail2ban-client reload
        - name: Ensure fail2ban is running
          ansible.builtin.service:
            name: fail2ban
            state: started
            enabled: true

    - name: Reload audit rules
      listen: Reload audit rules
      ansible.builtin.command: /sbin/augenrules --load

    - name: Restart auditd
      listen: Restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted
